get_account_status.description: See the connected key's API-AFL plan, when it renews, and how many of today's requests are used and left. It is free: it never counts against the day.

active.description: True while the subscription is active.

requests_remaining.description: Requests left today; the day starts at midnight UTC.

subscription_end.description: When the plan renews or ends.

get_game.description: Get one game by ID: its round, venue, status and both sides' goals, behinds and score, live while it is being played.
get_game.name: get_game

parameters.description: The game's ID, such as 3058. List games returns them.
parameters.name: game_id

parameters.description: Optional. Give dates and times in this time zone, such as Australia/Melbourne. UTC when left empty.
parameters.name: timezone

attendance.description: The crowd, when the API has it.

date.description: When it starts, with the time zone's offset (ISO 8601).

round.description: Regular Season, or Postseason or Post Season for the finals.

psbehinds.description: The API's psbehinds count, which was 0 in every game checked.

psgoals.description: The API's psgoals count, which was 0 in every game checked.

score.description: Points: six a goal and one a behind.

description: Follow Australian rules football with API-AFL: AFL Premiership games and live scores, quarter by quarter, goals and behinds by player, team and player statistics for a game and a season, the ladder and bookmakers' pre-match odds. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
